verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only general relevance-shaping tools: RRF fusion of full-text and vector rankings, a one-line marketing mention of reranking, and a pointer to Query DSL docs. These go beyond pure keyword matching but stay within textual and semantic similarity, and nothing in the pack shows business signals feeding the score. Missing for 10: documented custom scoring functions or ranking rules, boosting by business signals such as popularity, recency or margin, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of business-signal ranking.
